description: Move a saved post into a BAMF folder (created by name if missing). Folders work across platforms; moving into an auto-remix folder starts a remix.

auto_remix.description: When creating a folder: posts landing in it are remixed automatically.

platform_folder_name.description: When creating a folder: platform folders with this name (e.g. an X bookmark folder) land here.

name: bamf.move_to_folder
